name: browser-use
headline: claude code mcp manager: manage configurations
short_description: Bash script for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) configurations in Claude Code. Add, remove, list, and auto-load MCPs without manual intervention.
author: qdhenry

sections.overview:
Claude-Code-MCP-Manager is a bash automation tool that streamlines Model Context Protocol setup for Claude Code and compatible AI agents. It provides interactive commands to add, remove, list, and batch-manage MCP configurations stored in JSON format. The tool supports multiple MCP types (npx and environment variable-based), includes import/export functionality for configuration backup and sharing, and offers automatic loading capabilities through shell integration. Developers benefit from reduced manual configuration overhead, safer token management through centralized configuration files, and the ability to quickly switch between different MCP setups for different projects.
Set up and manage multiple MCP integrations (Supabase, DigitalOcean, Shopify, Puppeteer) without manual configuration
Automatically load pre-configured MCPs when launching Claude Code
Export and import MCP configurations for team collaboration and backup
Add and remove MCPs interactively or in batch operations
